question: Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan, a musical genius, learnt which of the following gharanas of music from his father at an early age?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kasur Patiala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**, a musical genius, learned from **Kasur Patiala Gharana **of music from his father at an early age.
 
• **Ustad Bade Ghulam Ali Khan was an Indian Hindustani classical vocalist, from the Patiala Gharana.**
 
• The most common epithet used to describe Ustad Ghulam Ali Khan is 'Tansen of the 20th century.
